pages.en: It is a dark and noisy night. There is a terrible storm outside. Tom is afraid, so he goes to Lily's room.
pages.zh: 这是一个又黑又吵的夜晚。外面有一场可怕的暴风雨。Tom 很害怕，就去了 Lily 的房间。
pages.scene: A dark bedroom at night, rain and lightning at the window, Tom standing at Lily's door holding his teddy bear, looking afraid.

pages.en: "Don't be afraid," says Lily. "Let's read a funny story." She reads to him, and Tom starts to laugh. Max comes in too.
pages.zh: “别害怕，”Lily 说，“我们来读一个好笑的故事吧。”她读给他听，Tom 开始笑了。Max 也进来了。
pages.scene: Lily and Tom sitting together on her bed under a blanket with a small lamp on, Lily reading a book aloud, Tom laughing, Max coming in through the door.

pages.en: In the morning, the sun is out. "I was brave last night," says Tom. "You were," says Lily, and they both laugh.
pages.zh: 早上，太阳出来了。“我昨晚很勇敢，”Tom 说。“你确实很勇敢，”Lily 说，两个人都笑了。
pages.scene: A sunny bedroom in the morning, Lily and Tom laughing together on the bed, the sky blue outside the window, Max wagging his tail.

questions.q: Tom is sad in the morning.
